Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to the Governor's Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's Safer at Home Order (revised March 21, 2020). All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82847724587
Zoom Meeting ID: 828 4772 4587
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code 828 4772 4587#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to submit email correspondence to CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org before the meeting begins. The email will be distributed to all councilmembers. Public correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: If you would like to address the City Council during the meeting, please email CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org with (1) the agenda item on which you'd like to speak, and (2) the phone number and/or Zoom display name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards. Please note: This will be the only way to sign up for public comment.

11.  Request for City Council Direction Related to Palos Verdes Estates Municipal
  Code Chapter 5.16 (Business License Tax) on the Applicability of Said Chapter
  to the Business of Renting/Leasing Single-Family Residential Properties for a
  Period Greater than Thirty (30) Days in the City

  Recommendation: (1) Determine that Chapter 5.16 (Business License Tax) does
  apply to the business of renting/leasing single-family residential properties for a
  period greater than thirty (30) days in the City, (2) Determine that newly identified
  single-family rental businesses shall be considered to have commenced business on
  or after October 1, 2020; and (3) in accordance with Palos Verdes Estates Municipal
  Code (PVEMC) Section 5.16.030(B), authorize the City Manager to collect from
  identified businesses the business license tax due beginning with the first day of the
  quarter of the license year in which it is applied for to the end of the license year, and
  (4) for any such businesses that have submitted payment for the Business License
  Tax for a period prior to October 1, 2020 (including any penalties and interest), the
  City Manager is authorized to issue a refund of such prior payments.

  ACTION: Moved by Mayor Pro Tem Kemps, Seconded by Councilmember
  Davidson to (1) Determine that Chapter 5.16 (Business License Tax) does apply to
  the business of renting/leasing single-family residential properties for a period greater
  than thirty (30) days in the City, (2) Determine that newly identified single-family
  rental businesses shall be considered to have commenced business on or after October
  1, 2020; and (3) in accordance with Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code (PVEMC)
  Section 5.16.030(B), authorize the City Manager to collect from identified businesses
  the business license tax due beginning with the first day of the quarter of the license
  year in which it is applied for to the end of the license year, and (4) for any such
  businesses that have submitted payment for the Business License Tax for a period
  prior to October 1, 2020 (including any penalties and interest), the City Manager is
  authorized to issue a refund of such prior payments.. The motion carried by the
  following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  NOES:  None

  Capital Budget and 2020 Projected Fiscal Results

  Recommendation: Approve the Palos Verdes Golf Club’s 2021 proposed operating
  and capital budget, dues and fee schedule and accept their 2020 projected fiscal results.

  Councilmember Lozzi recused herself from this item as a member of the Palos Verdes

  for Revenue Evaluation

  Angeles County Vote by Mail Drop Box outside and encouraged the public not to use
  unofficial drop boxes. She also noted an upcoming virtual coffee event with
  Assemblymember Al Muratsuchi.

  a. State of the Police Department – Oral Report – No report.

MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS

Marlene Breene addressed the City Council.

Councilmember Davidson requested a future agenda item for Term Limits.

Councilmember Lozzi announced that the Palos Verdes Peninsula Transit Authority will be
offering free dial-a-ride services on Election Day, and requested future agenda items for an
update on the Malaga Cove Traffic Plan, and that the City Council provide direction to Council
committees and the possibility of Council liaisons to committees.

Councilmember Kao expressed his appreciation to staff and the Council, noted he will be joining
the City Manager at the Virtual Coffee with Assemblymember Muratsuchi and expressed
concern that City Councilmembers need further guidance on voting delegate and liaison
decision-making with other organizations.

Mayor Pro Tem Kemps expressed his appreciation to staff and the Council, and noted his efforts
to improve technology in the City and Community.

Mayor McGowan noted that he and Councilmember Kao as Liaisons to the Palos Verdes Golf
Club are exploring potential revenue enhancement and development.
